Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

a thief goes away with a santro car at a speed of 50 kmph . the theft has been discovered after half an hour and the owner sets off in a bike at 60 kmph when will the owner over take the thief from the start ?

A. a ) 2
B. b ) 5
C. c ) 7
D. d ) 5
E. e ) 8

message.content:
The thief has a 25 km head start (50 × 0.5). The owner closes the gap at 10 kmph, taking 2.5 hours after discovery.

ANSWER: A
message.reasoning_content: Classic: 50·0.5=25 km gap, relative 10, catch at 2.5 h after discovery; from start 3 h? Options... answer 2.5? Options show 2,5,7,5,8 — likely 2.5 (a).

final_content:
The thief has a 25 km head start (50 × 0.5). The owner closes the gap at 10 kmph, taking 2.5 hours after discovery.

ANSWER: A
